# netbox_front_port_templates (Data Source)

Lists front_port_template objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_front_port_templates" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-front_port_template" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, module_type_id, module_type_id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, type, type__empty, type__ic, type__ie, type__iew, type__iregex, type__isw, type__n, type__nic, type__nie, type__niew, type__nisw, type__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `front_port_templates` (Attributes List) The matching front_port_templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--front_port_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--front_port_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `front_port_templates`

Read-Only:

- `color_hex` (String) RGB color in hex (e.g. ff0000).
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `module_type_id` (Number) Id of the module type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `name` (String)
- `positions` (Number) Number of positions on the front port, at least the number of rear_ports mappings. NetBox checks a lower value against the mappings it already holds, so remove mappings in one apply and lower positions in the next.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Rear port of a single-position front port: the same as rear_ports = [{position = 1, rear_port_id = ..., rear_port_position = ...}]. Conflicts with rear_ports and with positions > 1.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on rear_port_id. Requires rear_port_id.
- `rear_ports` (Attributes Set) Mappings of the front port's positions onto rear port templates of the same device type or module type, one object per position. Derived from rear_port_id and rear_port_position when those are set; an empty set, or neither form, leaves the port unmapped. Changing the set recreates every mapping, since NetBox 4.6 rejects an update that resends an existing one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--front_port_templates--rear_ports))
- `type` (String) Port type as its NetBox slug, e.g. 8p8c, lc, mpo (any of NetBox's port type choices).
- `url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--front_port_templates--rear_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `front_port_templates.rear_ports`

Read-Only:

- `position` (Number) Position on the front port, 1-based and unique per port.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Id of the rear port template the position maps to.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on that rear port, 1-based; each rear port position takes one mapping.
